newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Singapore's Jurong eyes more projects in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Jurong eyes more projects in Manila.

text.p: Jurong Town Corp of Singapore is considering expanding in the Philippines, Board of Investments governor Ofelia Bulaong said on Wednesday.
Jurong, which is involved in an industrial estate in northern Philippines, is looking for a 500 to 1,000 hectare lot to convert into another industrial estate, she told reporters.
It is also interested in setting up pharmaceutical and food packaging facilities.
Jurong, a government entity, is an industrial developer and manager of industrial facilities which aims to support manufacturing growth in Singapore.
